title: Rioproperty hero
description: A full-bleed photo hero with a giant wide capital headline across the bottom: words held to the left and right edges in staggered rows, a short stacked list and a capitalised blurb with a yellow-underlined link above it. On desktop it pins for three windows while every word flies apart sideways (left words out to the left, right words out to the right) and the scrim clears; on phones the same happens as it scrolls away. The photo then sinks so the next section slides over it. A violet curtain lifts off it on load.
notes: the media slot fills the window like object-fit cover; empty, it is a deep indigo-to-violet placeholder
needs a dark media or a dark secondary/glow: the text is paper-white over it
desktop (1024+) is three windows tall when pinned; pinned false keeps it one window
each word's drift (vw) sets where it flies; negative goes left
made to sit under rioproperty-header, which overlays it
name: rioproperty-hero
